_comment: Synthetic optimization recommendations for the RECPT MVP demo. Expected values are precomputed from the synthetic CSVs + model_coefficients.csv + grid_intensity.csv so the dashboard can validate its own math. All illustrative.

recommendations.title: Right-size Support-Bot summarization + shift region
recommendations.rationale: Support-Bot is ~76% of AI carbon and ~77% of AI cost. ~70% of its traffic is routine summarization that runs fine on a small model; the rest stays on the large model for complex tickets. Also shift ap-south (630 gCO2e/kWh) -> us-west (210).
recommendations.quality_note: 30% of traffic kept on the large model in-region to protect answer quality on complex tickets (honest trade-off, not a blanket downgrade).

recommendations.title: Carbon-aware region shift for Analytics-Agent
recommendations.rationale: Same workload, cleaner grid: move Analytics-Agent us-east (380) -> us-west (210). Cost unchanged (token price is region-independent) — a pure carbon win that shows carbon-aware decisions, not just cost-driven ones.
recommendations.quality_note: No model change; no quality impact.
